name: Blackout on Bell Street
premise: A city block loses power while a missing-person report arrives. Evidence and witness memories may disagree.

sol.name: Sol
experience: Knows the local clinic, not the missing person
sol.intent: Find the injured before the street becomes unsafe

goals: Investigate the central mystery without losing your companions

events.title: An arrival

events.title: A distant complication
events.description: An unseen faction begins looking for the same answer.

canon.text: The clinic has a battery radio. The power company scheduled no maintenance tonight.
